mission_01: Semantic HTML gives meaning to your markup so browsers, search engines, and assistive technologies understand your page structure. In this mission, you will convert a page built entirely with generic <div> elements into properly structured semantic HTML. Replace the outer container divs with <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>, <aside>, and <footer> elements. Use appropriate heading levels (h1 for the page title, h2 for section titles) to create a clear document outline. This improves SEO, accessibility, and code readability.
